completion_policy.rule: A simulated model must declare its bus/controller data plane, an injection interface and at least one device on which the UIFlow2 path was exercised. A partial or planned model must declare a concrete blocker. Device manifests must expose the same blocker set. Hardware requirements and modeled components are checked in both directions so a new device cannot hide a peripheral outside its inventory. Every runtime case must declare the exact models it covers, and every simulated component must have a device-local case. A device with any unfinished component must be explicitly allowlisted for temporary backend work; all new devices must be peripheral-complete.

tab5.reason: The native ESP32-P4 backend still lacks dynamic I2C, I2S/PCM, MIPI-CSI, USB Host and SDIO data planes.

gpio-button.data_plane: Board GPIO input state changes through the ESP32 GPIO register model; QMP key events or the NanoC6 machine button property drive the physical pin level consumed by the M5Unified button state machine or machine.Pin

pwr-button.data_plane: QMP key:p pulses the board power-key wire or PMIC power-key interrupt; M5Unified reads the resulting GPIO/register state through the normal board path

bq27220.data_plane: BQ27220 standard 16-bit command words, byte ordering, seal/unseal control and block reads over ESP32-C6 I2C or BCM2837 Linux i2c-bcm2835; QOM voltage, current and SOC reach Linux power_supply and the UIFlow2 Power API

aw32001.data_plane: AW32001 charger configuration and status registers over ESP32-C6 I2C

ip2326.data_plane: Tab5 PI4IOE5V6408 active-low CHG_STAT input and CHG_EN output over the P4 I2C controller; charging (0x0F=0x00) and discharging (0x0F=0x40) both reach Power.isCharging(), while IP2326 current and termination behavior are not yet modelled
ip2326.blocker: PI4IOE CHG_STAT/CHG_EN and Power.isCharging() decode pass for charging and discharging, but no IP2326 analog current/termination state machine or hot state injection exists; changing state requires a new emulator launch

ip2315.data_plane: Autonomous IP2315 power path represented by a QOM charger object with VBUS/NTC state; CardputerZero charge/discharge injection flips the BQ27220 signed-current register, while PaperMono exposes the IP2315 I2C charge-enable and REG_CHG_STAT(0xC7) state consumed by M5Unified Power.isCharging()

esp32c6-hosted.data_plane: ESP32-P4 SDIO2 host and ESP32-C6 slave are coupled through an esp-emu Unix stream; the C6 network-adapter firmware executes the WiFi/BLE control and packet paths

touch-ft5x06.data_plane: FT5x06 I2C configuration and touch-report registers; QMP pointer events update controller reports consumed by the M5GFX touch driver

touch-si12t.data_plane: Si12T register configuration and OUTPUT1 touch-bit decoding over ESP32-S3 I2C

touch-cst820.data_plane: CST820 I2C touch-report registers; QMP pointer events update the controller report consumed by the M5GFX touch driver

touch-st7123.data_plane: Firmware-side GDB mailbox feeds the M5GFX Touch_ST7123 raw-read hook; the native esp-emu P4 backend does not expose the ST7123 I2C controller transactions or DSI touch data plane
touch-st7123.blocker: Add an ST7123 I2C model plus a native P4 I2C/QOM bridge, then inject touch through controller registers instead of the M5GFX raw-read hook

keyboard-tca8418.data_plane: TCA8418 matrix-controller config, write-one-to-clear interrupt status and FIFO; QMP events drive BCM GPIO27 or ESP32 GPIO11 and are decoded by Linux tca8418_keypad or UIFlow2 KeyboardI2C

m5pm1.data_plane: M5PM1 power, GPIO, ADC, PWM, NeoPixel RAM, IRQ status/mask, wake source, watchdog, timer and RTC RAM registers over the device I2C bus

axp192.data_plane: AXP192 chip ID, status, battery/VBUS/APS ADC registers, charge configuration/current and GPIO/IRQ register file over ESP32 I2C

axp2101.data_plane: AXP2101 battery, VBUS, charge-status, ADC and power-key registers over the board I2C bus; QOM electrical values are decoded by the UIFlow2 Power API

m5ioe1.data_plane: M5IOE1 GPIO direction/output/input, pulls, drive mode, ADC, temperature, PWM, IRQ status and NeoPixel RAM over the device I2C bus; Linux binds pinctrl, PWM and ADC children

aw9523.data_plane: AW9523B input/output/direction/interrupt registers, GPIO mode outputs and injected input banks over ESP32-S3 I2C

pi4ioe5v6408.data_plane: PI4IOE5V6408 direction, output, high-impedance, pull, input-default, input-status, interrupt-mask and interrupt-status registers with QMP button injection

rx8130.data_plane: RX8130CE BCD date/time and control registers over the board I2C bus; UIFlow2 tests use raw I2C register transactions because machine.RTC only controls the SoC system clock, while QOM absolute/relative time injection drives the same controller-visible registers

pcf8563.data_plane: PCF8563/BM8563 BCD date/time and control registers over the board I2C bus; UIFlow2 tests use raw I2C register transactions because machine.RTC only controls the SoC system clock, while QOM absolute/relative time injection drives the same controller-visible registers

bmi270.data_plane: BMI270 CHIP_ID, soft reset, INIT_DATA/INIT_CTRL, data-ready status and little-endian accel/gyro sample registers over the board I2C bus; QOM physical values reach Linux IIO or the UIFlow2 Imu API

bmm150.data_plane: BMM150 sensor-hub registers reached through the BMI270 auxiliary-I2C interface; QOM magnetic-field values are encoded into little-endian sample registers read by Linux IIO or UIFlow2 Imu

mpu6886.data_plane: MPU6886 configuration and big-endian accel/gyro sample registers over ESP32 I2C0; QOM physical-value injection reaches the UIFlow2 Imu API

es8311.data_plane: ES8311 I2C configuration plus ESP32-S3 I2S TX/RX and cyclic GDMA; host PCM capture and deterministic RX PCM injection

es7210.data_plane: ES7210 I2C configuration plus ESP32-S3 I2S RX and cyclic GDMA; deterministic host PCM injection reaches the UIFlow2 microphone buffer

es8388.data_plane: Target: ES8388 I2C control registers plus ESP32-P4 I2S TX/RX descriptor and PCM endpoints
es8388.blocker: esp-emu 0.50.0 has no I2S register or PCM data plane and no writable I2C-device/QOM bridge for ES8388; a QEMU P4 backend or a native I2S/I2C extension is required

es8389.data_plane: ES8389 8-bit I2C register map, identity registers 0x83/0x89 and CSM_STATE1=0x0D, plus BCM2835 I2S MMIO/FIFO and DREQ-driven cyclic DMA; ALSA playback is captured from TX and deterministic RX PCM is returned byte-exactly through arecord

aw88298.data_plane: AW88298 I2C control plus ESP32-S3 I2S TX and cyclic GDMA; host PCM capture

aw8737a.data_plane: AW8737A PA enable path with ESP32-S3 I2S TX and cyclic GDMA; host PCM capture

aw8737a-bcm2837.data_plane: ES8389/BCM2835 I2S playback PCM reaches the codec DAI while Linux DAPM enables the AW8737A path through BCM GPIO24; QEMU records the GPIO24 assertion and captures the DMA PCM stream

ns4168.data_plane: Core2 v1.1 ESP32 I2S1 linked-list DMA with AXP2101 ALDO3 amplifier enable; host PCM capture

spm1423.data_plane: Core2 v1.1 ESP32 I2S0 PDM RX and legacy linked-list DMA; deterministic PCM injection reaches the UIFlow2 microphone buffer

pdm-microphone.data_plane: PDM RX through the ESP32-S3 I2S/GDMA path; deterministic host PCM injection

gc0308.data_plane: ESP32-S3 LCD_CAM + GDMA RGB565 frame chunks; M5SW_CAMERA_FRAME file injection

lp5562.data_plane: LP5562 enable/mode and independent R/G/B PWM registers over ESP32-S3 I2C

ns4150b.data_plane: NS4150B GPIO enable plus the upstream I2S TX and cyclic GDMA PCM path; host capture verifies speaker data

sc2356.data_plane: Target: SC2356 SCCB register model and two-lane MIPI CSI-2 frame stream into the ESP32-P4 CSI controller
sc2356.blocker: The native esp-emu P4 backend exposes no MIPI CSI-2 controller or frame endpoint; Tab5 camera is therefore not simulated

camera-imx219.data_plane: IMX219 CCI stores the mode-select, lane mode, output window, frame/line length, exposure, analogue/digital gain, orientation and test-pattern registers written by the Linux driver. BCM2837 Unicam CSI1 consumes the programmed format/stride/DMA addresses and generates RG10 frames from those sensor registers before raising CAM1 frame-start/frame-end interrupts

ethernet-sr9900a.data_plane: SR9900A vendor registers implement the RTL8152B programming model; Linux r8152 binds at USB High-Speed, creates eth0 and exchanges RTL8152 TX/RX descriptors through GL852G, USB bulk endpoints and a host socket packet bridge

sht40.data_plane: SHT4x command measurements, temperature/humidity conversion and per-word CRC8 over ESP32-S3 I2C

lm75.data_plane: LM75BDP pointer-register read and 11-bit two's-complement temperature encoding over StamPLC I2C0 at 0x48

ina226.data_plane: INA226 configuration, calibration, shunt-voltage, bus-voltage, current and power registers over the board I2C bus; QOM electrical values reach the UIFlow2 power path

ina3221.data_plane: INA3221 three-channel register model over ESP32 I2C0; manufacturer/die ID, 8 mV bus-voltage LSB and 40 uV shunt-voltage LSB with QOM physical-value injection

ltr-553als-wa.data_plane: LTR553ALS-WA identity, ALS control, four-byte ambient-light burst and 11-bit proximity registers over ESP32-S3 I2C

ir-tx-rx.data_plane: ESP32-S3 RMT APB registers + RMTMEM symbols; TX_END/RX_END interrupts; NEC packet capture and injection

ir-tx-rx-bcm2837.data_plane: BCM GPIO13 active-low receiver edges feed Linux gpio-ir-receiver/LIRC mode2; Linux gpio-ir-tx drives BCM GPIO12 and QEMU captures timestamped output edges for NEC sends

ir-tx-c6.data_plane: ESP32-C6 RMT TX channels, APB FIFO and hardware symbol RAM with host symbol capture; NanoC6 GPIO3 and Nesso N1 GPIO9

rgb-led.data_plane: M5IOE1 I2C NeoPixel RGB565 RAM, PaperMono M5PM1 red rail + M5IOE1 green/blue PWM, and ESP32-S3/C6 RMT WS2812/GRB symbol capture with host-side wire decoding; NanoC6 also verifies GPIO19 RGBPWR and GPIO20 data

gpio-led.data_plane: GPIO output enable and level registers drive the board LED wire; the NanoC6 machine exposes GPIO7 level through QOM so the test can verify on/off transitions

vibration.data_plane: M5IOE1 PWM1 12-bit duty and enable registers driving the StopWatch motor output

buzzer.data_plane: PaperMono GPIO42 and StamPLC G44 Speaker buzzer modes generate 1-bit delta-sigma I2S TX streams; cyclic GDMA and host PCM capture verify firmware output

i2s-buzzer-c6.data_plane: ESP32-C6 I2S TX, cyclic AHB GDMA OUT descriptors, OUT_EOF interrupt delivery and host PCM capture carrying the M5Unified 1-bit delta-sigma buzzer waveform on Nesso N1 GPIO11

can.data_plane: ESP32-S3 TWAI/SJA1000 controller on StamPLC G42/G43 with a QEMU CAN-bus peer for TX/RX echo and interrupt delivery

rs485.data_plane: Half-duplex UART RS-485 mode with byte-level host peer TX/RX; exercised on StamPLC UART2 G0/G39/G46 and Tab5 UART1 G20/G21 with direction GPIO34

servo.data_plane: StackChan SCS serial-bus model with PING, READ, WRITE/REG_WRITE and SYNC_WRITE packets, position/torque telemetry, and UART1 TX/RX injection

nfc-st25r3916.data_plane: ST25R3916 I2C command/register/FIFO protocol, ISO14443A REQA/anticollision/SELECT and NTAG page read/write

nfc-st25r3916-spi.data_plane: ST25R3916 SPI/NFCCap command/register/Space-B/FIFO transport with deterministic ISO14443A NTAG read and write over the Cardputer-ADV shared SPI2 bus

lora-sx1262.data_plane: SX1262 SPI command/argument/status/register/TX-RX FIFO protocol, IRQ status, packet metadata and local TX-to-RX loopback over ESP32-S3 GP-SPI3/GDMA and Nesso N1 GPIO20-GPIO23 soft-SPI pins

cc1101-subghz.data_plane: CC1101 configuration/status registers, command strobes, packet FIFO and local TX-to-RX loopback over the Cardputer-ADV shared SPI2 bus and GDO0 completion line

sd-card.data_plane: QEMU SD card block backend attached with -drive if=sd; raw image read/write sectors

sd-card-spi.data_plane: GP-SPI SD SPI command/data model with CMD0/8/9/10/13/16/17/24/51/55/58/59 and ACMD41/SD_STATUS; raw image sector backing and CRC16

usb-host.data_plane: CoreS3 M-Bus SPI MAX3421E register/FIFO model with USB Chapter 9 enumeration and interrupt-IN HID mouse reports; QOM injects x/y/buttons

usb-host-p4-dwc.data_plane: Target: ESP32-P4 DWC USB 2.0 host controller, root port, HID/CDC endpoint models and host-side packet bridge
usb-host-p4-dwc.blocker: The native esp-emu P4 backend exposes no USB host controller or endpoint attachment API

usb-hub-gl852g.data_plane: BCM2837 DWC2 enumerates a GL852G-compatible MTT hub with VID:PID 05e3:0610 and four downstream ports. The TT compatibility path keeps the child model at its real full/low speed while exposing a high-speed upstream port to the HCD, then forwards control, bulk and interrupt traffic through the hub; SR9900A and a low-speed USB HID both enumerate and reach Linux through that path

linux-bcm2837.data_plane: Official CardputerZero ARM64 image boots on QEMU BCM2837 with the physical 512 MiB RAM, M5Stack DTB overlays, panel-mipi-dbi ST7789v3 DRM framebuffer and Linux input events

peripheral_blockers.reason: No P4 MIPI CSI-2 controller or SCCB/frame bridge in esp-emu 0.50.0

Tab5 I2C reaches BMI270 and can store CHIP_ID=0x24 when written from main.py, but the UIFlow2 boot sequence clears the preloaded identity and the P4 backend has no BMI270 reset/init state machine or dynamic sample injection

Tab5 direct machine.I2C write/read reaches RX8130 registers, but time progression and dynamic host time injection remain absent. machine.RTC changes only the P4 system clock and is not counted as external RTC evidence
Tab5 INA226 register preload reaches the official Power API as 8000 mV / 1248 mA / 87%, but dynamic host injection, alert and GPIO/IRQ side effects remain absent
Both U6/U7 device IDs 0xA2 and output-register write/readback pass, but GPIO side effects and interrupt injection remain absent
No P4 I2S RX/GDMA or PCM injection endpoint exists in esp-emu 0.50.0
No ES8388 I2C model or P4 I2S TX/PCM capture endpoint exists
PA enable is known, but the Tab5 ES8388-to-NS4150B PCM path cannot be captured without P4 I2S
Touch is visible only through a firmware GDB hook, not ST7123 controller/I2C transactions
No ESP32-P4 USB host controller or endpoint attachment model
No Tab5 SDIO1 block-device attachment has been exercised on the native P4 backend

PI4IOE CHG_STAT/CHG_EN and Power.isCharging() decode pass for charging (0x00) and discharging (0x40), but no IP2326 analog current/termination state machine or hot state injection exists; changing state requires a new emulator launch
